basic_info.description: Located in the desirable Sunset District, this charming home features a covered tunnel entrance and breathtaking ocean views from the back of the house. Inside, the inviting living room showcases a cozy fireplace, leading to a formal dining room and a bright eat-in kitchen with new fridge and stove. The spacious two-car tandem garage provides convenience and potential for expansion. Ideally situated near the reservoir, public transportation, and a variety of shopping and dining options, this home offers classic charm, stunning views, and endless possibilities in a prime location.
